Event-stream byte pins of every legacy-links.json scenario + the
committed pool-wasm break fixture, re-simulated on the pre-012
canonical wasm (0.1.0+5bd2803) at commit ce8f9db7b2f8657dee05aa392ac3f10996b56294.
events_sha256 = sha256 over JSON.stringify(record.events) — the
ECMAScript-normalized event-stream serialization (version-free, so
it must stay BYTE-IDENTICAL across the additive-only 012 kernel
rebuild). The pre-012 wasm binary + glue are archived at
web/tools/fixtures/pre012-wasm/ so e2e-share.mjs --corpus can
re-simulate the old side directly. DO NOT regenerate — this file is
the oracle for the 012 determinism cascade.
FEATURE-018 DEFAULT FLIP REPIN (flip-cascade.md §3, 2026-07-11):
ONLY the pool-wasm-break-fixture entry moved — the kernel default
cluster model flipped to CompliantChain (commit 3856cb9), so the
fixture’s default event stream legitimately changed (114 → 195
events; honest diff, NOT additive). The 13 legacy-links pins are
version-pinned to their own kernels and DID NOT move. Four of them
(the sessions’ break shots: v1-default-two-shots#0,
v2-grip-worn-foul-bih#0, v2-mathavan-default-cloth#0,
v3-full-equipment-foul-bih#0) also
diverge under the flipped default — e2e-share.mjs --corpus admits a
divergence ONLY when the EXPLICIT SequentialImpulse scenario on the
new wasm reproduces the pinned stream byte-identically, proving the
delta is attributable exactly to the flipped cluster default and the
legacy resolver is untouched (research R12). The break-fixture entry
keeps pre_flip_events_sha256 so the arm also proves the archived
pre-012 wasm still reproduces the old stream. The (old, new) kernel
pair is NOT in KERNEL_COMPAT_LINEAGE: byte identity cannot be proven
for break records, so cross-version opens show the standard warning +
view-anyway (generalization-audit row 12 posture).
ISSUE-87 SLIP-LAW REPIN (2026-07-22, refs #77 #83 #87): ONLY the
pool-wasm-break-fixture entry moved again — the ball-ball slip-branch
friction impulse was corrected to the (1+e_b)/2 Coulomb cap (#77,
default BallBallSlipLaw::CoulombCap) and the Stronge terminal
stick→slip root selection was made continuous in incidence (#83,
default StrongeSlipSelect::FirstCrossing), so the fixture’s default
event stream legitimately changed (195 → 189 events; honest diff).
The pre-#77 default stream is RETAINED as pre_77_events_sha256 /
pre_77_n_events (018-flip discipline): the NEW kernel reproduces it
byte-identically with the explicit legacy pin
ball_ball_slip_law: PostImpactNormalDelta (Han2005 cushion — #83 is
not in play for this fixture; StrongeCompliant scenarios additionally
pin slip_select: LegacyBracket). The 13 legacy-links pins are
version-pinned to their own kernels and DID NOT move. The four
sessions’ break shots (v1-default-two-shots#0, v2-grip-worn-foul-bih#0,
v2-mathavan-default-cloth#0, v3-full-equipment-foul-bih#0) diverge
additionally under the corrected slip law — e2e-share.mjs --corpus
admits each divergence ONLY when the EXPLICIT legacy-options scenario
(SequentialImpulse + Planar + PostImpactNormalDelta + LegacyBracket
where StrongeCompliant) on the new wasm reproduces the pinned stream
byte-identically (proven 5/5 at the repin; the slip-only pins
PostImpactNormalDelta/LegacyBracket also reproduce the pre-fix
0.1.0+b40cc77 DEFAULT streams byte-identically — the delta is
attributable exactly to #77/#83). The (old, new) kernel pair stays out
of KERNEL_COMPAT_LINEAGE (ballball-slip-cap-compat.md (internal)).
